candidate_reason_changes.old_reason: Ecclesiastes compares people overtaken by an unknown evil time with fish and birds caught in nets. It does not establish Proverbs' claim that nets for winged creatures are not unjustly spread; a direct argumentative equivalence remains pending.
candidate_reason_changes.new_reason: Ecclesiastes compares people overtaken by an unknown evil time with fish caught in an evil net and birds caught in a snare. It does not establish Proverbs' claim that nets for winged creatures are not unjustly spread; a direct argumentative equivalence remains pending.
